allocator.instance: Factory Director — deterministic policy branch (trivial case: exactly one configured eligible worker per role)
allocator.cognition_tier: deterministic; no local or frontier model consulted
authority_basis: SWF-35: incremental Wave 2 release requires a fully bound execution packet and separate release admission
SF-REQ-026 amendment: deterministic policy settles trivial cases without a model
SWF-09 hard duration requirement and live execution.supervision configuration

selection.execution_path: existing factory lifecycle: Work Management READY → explicit Release → IMPLEMENT (PRODUCER) → VERIFY (VERIFIER) → REVIEW → ACCEPT → DONE, executed by the retained bootstrap (KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED, retirement matrix) with the live self-hosting profile

verifier.independence: separate GitHub identity and worktree; fresh verifier worktree retrieves the exact candidate SHA

selection.why: The current self-hosting profile configures exactly one Codex worker for PRODUCER and one for VERIFIER, with distinct GitHub identities and worktree custody. This allocation does not change provider configuration or launch a worker.

limits.policy: SWF-09 requires hard enforcement of wall-clock, attempts, retries, concurrency and cancellation. The reviewed per-BIU dispatcher guard enforces attempts and replacements only when this BIU's exact normal Issue identity is bound through execution.biuLimits in the active profile. Tokens and cost are measured, never assumed zero.

concurrency.enforcement: bootstrap lane claim repository#issue:ROLE (synchronous check-and-reserve, ACTIVE_INVOCATION_EXISTS); WIP = 1

attempts.enforcement: reviewed retained dispatcher per-BIU cycle guard; after the exact normal Issue identity is bound through active execution.biuLimits, it refuses VERIFY REJECT→IMPLEMENT at the configured cap without treating a same-phase replacement as a cycle.

retries_within_phase.value: 1 replacement worker per phase on non-terminal outcome (does not increment the cycle, SWF-32 §6)
retries_within_phase.enforcement: reviewed retained dispatcher per-BIU phase guard; after the exact normal Issue identity is bound through active execution.biuLimits, it refuses an additional worker above the configured replacement cap, including liveness reconciliation and replay paths.

wall_clock.value: 120000 ms startup + 7200000 ms runtime + 300000 ms stop grace = 7620000 ms (127 min) total per invocation
wall_clock.enforcement: live execution.supervision.mode=systemd; transient owned unit sets TimeoutStartSec, RuntimeMaxSec, TimeoutStopSec and KillMode=control-group; no direct-execution fallback

cancellation.value: operator stop of the active invocation; owned systemd unit terminates its process tree
cancellation.enforcement: operator control plane and configured systemd supervision

tokens_and_cost.value: measured where the provider reports them; UNKNOWN otherwise; never zero; no numeric token or monetary ceiling allocated

paid_provider_calls.value: configured Codex provider-default funding profile; usage/cost UNKNOWN until observed

remaining_allowance.basis: No numeric token/cost allowance exists in planning authority (candidate budget.execution_allocation); Founder-authorized bootstrap execution-budget policy allocates 3 execution cycles, 0 consumed, and one replacement worker per phase. No S1 worker invocation is authorized by this allocation alone.

escalation.budget_exhaustion: Factory Director must preserve the dispatcher EXECUTION_CYCLE_LIMIT hold and route a cycle-3 verification rejection to HumanDecisionRequired via Decision Inbox (SF-REQ-035); no fourth cycle is authorized
escalation.architecture_question: Architecture Decision Required (AA A5) via Decision Inbox; branch stops
escalation.provider_capacity: classify PROVIDER_CAPACITY_INTERRUPTION, not a task failure; the retained dispatcher admits at most one replacement worker per phase and holds further replacement attempts
escalation.duration_exhaustion: a hard duration stop yields a terminal supervision receipt; it does not grant a new retry or cycle

not_granted_here: Release authority is NOT YET GRANTED. SWF-35 standing grant applies only after native Agent Ready READY, Work Management READY, predecessor evidence, an exact active-profile execution.biuLimits binding, fully bound packet and release-admission checks. This allocation does not authorize a transition.
